metadata.title: World Indigenous People's Day | Recipe with Jackfruit seeds, bamboo shoot, Fermented Fish & Lye
metadata.description:
9th of August is observed as the ‘Day of Worlds Indigenous People’. 
The constitution of India calls the aboriginal ethnic groups of India as the “Scheduled Tribes”.
They are India’s indigenous people. 705 ethnic groups are notified as scheduled Tribes, and we comprise about 9 percent of the total population of India.
The largest concentration is in Northeast region and the central tribal belt, which stretches from Rajasthan to West Bengal.
The tribal’s in India, much like elsewhere, live on the frontiers symbolically, psychologically as well as physically.
 Though the indigenous people have learnt to live in the most hostile environment conditions, they are yet to learn to live in a hostile class and caste based society, where the tribal’s are considered distant part of the society on the far fringes to be treated with nothing but sympathetic toleration.
Let’s work together to build a more just and equal society. 

Image Credit: www.Pexels.com
Music Credit: www.Bensound.com
